Sophia: Quick heads-up 1 billing variant rollout is scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT. Need final signoff on three items: price-sheet CSV, grandfathering window logic, and telemetry labels. Drive: https://drive.redwood/price-sheets/v5. @Alan @Maya can you confirm?
Alan: Taking a look now. Found a rounding discrepancy on tier_3 monthly rate. Will patch CSV and re-export.
Maya: Noted. Also the vendor_fees column is missing for partner SKUs. Adding it now (gives +2m lines but trivial).
Sophia: Thanks. Once updated can someone run the invoice-sim for cohort B and post results here? @billingbot please run invoice-sim for cohort_B and attach summary.
billingbot: invoice-sim started for cohort_B...
billingbot: invoice-sim complete: cohort_B projected delta +3.2% net revenue, 14 accounts flagged as high-impact (top 7 heavy-embedding). Detailed report: https://redwood/internal/invoice-sim/1964123456
Jules: The flagged accounts cluster by embedding-heavy usage and reserved capacity. Recommend temporary promo codes for top7 to soften churn risk.
Alan: Agree with Jules. Also recommend reducing cohort size from 10% -> 8% while we monitor. I'll update rollout config and post snippet.
Alan: Config update:
```
rollout:
  cohort_B_pct: 0.08
  start_time: "2026-04-15T17:00:00Z"
  telemetry_labels: ["price_v5", "cohort_b"]
```
Maya: Vendor fees column added and CSV exported. New CSV path in drive: https://drive.redwood/price-sheets/v5/price-sheet-v5-export.csv
Sophia: OK 1 gating final deploy on three confirmations: (1) Alan confirms config push, (2) Maya confirms CSV export is final, (3) Jules + accounting sign off on promo budget and copy. If we have all confirmations by 9am PT I'll proceed.
Alan: Config pushed to deploy-configs repo. :thumbsup:
Jules: Drafting promo copy and will loop accounting. Adding @Priya-finance for approval.
Priya-finance: Quick check 1 promo budget approved up to $12k. Accounting gives green light for temporary credits or discount codes.
Sophia: Great. Proceeding with scheduled rollout. Will post 1-hour and 24-hour post-deploy revenue and churn signals back to #finance.
